description_en: Submits a personal income tax record screenshot for forgery detection and returns a task ID
description_zh: 提交个人所得税记录截图进行伪造检测，返回任务ID
name: CreateImageIncomeTaxDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: The URL of the income tax screenshot to detect. Only HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported. The image size cannot exceed 10 MB. External images are not supported. Only URLs accessible from the Chinese mainland public network are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待检测个税截图的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，图片大小不超过 10 MB。暂不支持外网图片，仅支持国内公网可访问的 URL
parameters.name: image_url

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value `OK` is returned if the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value `200` is returned if the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value `success` is returned if the request was successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The income tax screenshot detection task ID. Use this ID to query the result by calling GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult
TaskId.description_zh: 个税截图检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult 查询
TaskId.title_en: 个税截图检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult 查询
TaskId.title_zh: 个税截图检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult 查询
